title: Isolate a character's head
description: Used by the max preset: takes a crop of a character and redraws only the head, hair or headwear, beard and neck on a white background, ready for its own 3D run.
prompt_template: Edit this image. Show only the head of this character, isolated on a plain white background. Include the whole head exactly as in this image: the face, the ears, all of the hair, any hat, hood, helmet or other headwear, any beard at exactly the same length and width, and the neck down to where it meets the shoulders; the neck ends there in a clean cut. Remove the shoulders, the chest, the arms and the rest of the body completely. Keep the face exactly the same: the same features, skin colour, hair colour, wrinkles, scars and expression. Strict front view, face dead-on to the camera, no head tilt, the whole head and neck centred with an empty white margin around them. Same 3D render style, soft even studio light, sharp high detail. {prompt}
